recommendation: Recommend sharedBaselineCentered (Brutalist only): measure shaped CTLine ink bounds for the full alphabet+Sanskrit sample set; reserve a Didot caption band; place one shared baseline so the max ink envelope clears the caption and cell top, centering that envelope when slack remains. Stacker: glyph 15 + Didot 10 → min cell height 45 (use 46×40). Didot 11 needs height 46. Symbols at glyph 18 need height ≥50 (Didot 10) or ≥51 (Didot 11), or keep height 46 and use glyph 15–16. Reject typoPack (line box ~2.8× ink). inkCenterEach fits shorter cells but breaks cross-cell baseline alignment. Keep Bubblegum on fixed offsets + mono 9 captions.
